messages:
Aisha: Heads up — were seeing degraded embedding ingest for several trial/onboard tenants since ~02:10 UTC. Affected: ~48 tenants, incl ~12 high-touch activations.
Marco: Which customers are at risk for churn/renewal impact?
Aisha: 12 enterprise trials in activation window. If they hit errors during onboarding demos, risk goes up.
Dan: We traced it to the new batching switch in the embedding service. Some batches are exceeding memory threshold and falling back to retries, increasing latency.
Priya: Can we give a temporary workaround to customers so demos dont fail?
Dan: Yes. We can route their embedding calls to the warm dedicated embedding pool (lower concurrency, higher cost). I can enable routing per-tenant now.
Aisha: Recommend: immediate routing for the 12 high-touch tenants + one-time goodwill credit + priority onboarding office hours slot.
Elena: For customer text, avoid phrases like "we caused" or "we failed". Use: "we experienced an intermittent slowdown" and "were offering a one-time account credit as a gesture of goodwill." Include escalation path.
Marco: Credit amount? For activation-risk accounts propose 25% of impacted usage or $500 min. Approve?
Priya: Ill draft brief outreach and localized fragments (EN/FR/DE). Keep it short and actionable.
Aisha: Draft short email: 

Hi <Customer>,

We noticed intermittent slowdowns affecting embedding uploads earlier today. Weve routed your requests to a stable fallback pool and are monitoring performance. As a gesture of goodwill we will apply a one-time account credit and offer a priority onboarding session to complete your integration.

If youd like a live walkthrough, book here: <booking link>.

— Aisha, Customer Success

Aisha: @Dan confirm routing + ETA on full fix?
Dan: Routing enabled 03:02 UTC for those 12 tenants (IDs added to INC-2024-1123). Metrics show error rate down ~90% within 10 minutes. Root cause patch ETA 68 hours but could be sooner.
OpsBot: Incident created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2024-1123  state: investigating (auto).
Marco: Action list: (1) Route 12 customers (done), (2) Draft credit proposal for leadership (25% / $500 min), (3) Prep outreach + localized copies, (4) Schedule office hours and reserve 2 engineers, (5) Add per-tenant routing confirmation IDs to incident.
Priya: Ill have EN/FR/DE drafts + a short FAQ snippet in 40m. FAQ to include: what happened, steps we took, how credits are applied, how to escalate.
Elena: Ill review outreach copy once credit amount is final. Need explicit line on how to claim credit or that itll be applied automatically.
Aisha: Ill coordinate CS send and ping Sales for any exec-level outreach. Will post final send + list of tenants. :thumbsup:
Marco: Please include estimated time-to-resolution in outbound comms (use conservative 68h window) and note were monitoring.
Aisha: Will do. Adding short reply templates for common inbound Qs (status, credits, escalation) and attach to the incident.
Dan: Logged a short debugging snippet in the incident for eng: 

```
[03:00:12 UTC] embedding.batch: mem spike -> retry
[03:02:00 UTC] routing: applied tenant fallback route -> warm-pool
[03:09:40 UTC] errors -> down 92%
```

Aisha: Thanks team. Ill send the 12 tenants the outreach within 1h after Legal + Finance sign-off on credit amount.
Marco: Good. Keep this thread for CS-only notes; well post a separate public status update in #incidents when we have the RCA.
